pages.title: The trip
pages.text: Four of us, three days and one rental van that smelled of mezcal by day two. The Sierra Norte sits an hour above Oaxaca city at close to 3,000 metres, and the trails fall off it in every direction: pine forest up top, cactus and red dirt by the bottom.

pages.title: Ixtepeji ridge laps
pages.text: A warm-up loop to find out whether our lungs worked at altitude. They mostly didn't. The singletrack along the ridge made up for it: fast, loamy and lined with pines the whole way round.

pages.title: La Cumbre to San Felipe
pages.text: The big descent. Well over a kilometre of drop from the pines to the edge of the city. Tom flatted twice before the first overlook and blamed the cactus both times. Tlayudas at the bottom fixed everything.

pages.title: Cuajimoloyas to Latuvi
pages.text: Village to village through the cloud forest on the Pueblos Mancomunados trails. Fog for the first hour, then nothing but views. Best day of riding any of us has had.
Same time next year. Diego is already looking at flights.
